task:
Issue labels are saved exactly as they're sent, so " Bug", "bug" and "BUG" end up as three different labels on one issue.

In the backend's issueService.create and issueService.update, clean the labels before saving: trim each label, drop empty ones, and remove duplicates ignoring case, keeping the first spelling and the original order. For example [" Bug", "bug", "", "ui ", "UI"] becomes ["Bug", "ui"]. Add tests.
